answer: Bind each payout to a sequential memory-hard chain that cannot be parallelised: every identity must extend its own prior echo with fresh epoch entropy, so n clones need n machines and n full runtimes, not one shared solve. Auditors seed fable canaries, plausible fake answers only copy-bots repeat, and slash clusters that echo them. Rewards rest in lagoon escrow until canary and chain checks clear, making mass fakery expensive per head, not merely slower.
